verdict.rationale: SavvyCal explicitly supports Zapier for CRM syncing and workflow automations (create/update CRM records), plus webhooks and a REST API for custom integrations, which together enable bookings to flow into CRM/automation stacks without manual copying. However, there is no evidence of native, first-party Salesforce or HubSpot integrations — only generic Zapier and webhook/API-based paths, which require setup/configuration rather than a turnkey connection. Missing for 10: dedicated Salesforce/HubSpot native integrations, documented pre-built Zaps or CRM field-mapping templates, and independent case studies confirming reliable no-manual-copy CRM sync in practice.
